E011.notApplicable: IntelliJ ImplicitUsageProvider: marks methods carrying PostLoad/PostPersist/PrePersist-style callback annotations as used so the platform 'unused declaration' inspection stays quiet. The OpenIDEA plugin API has no implicit-usage extension point and jpa-assist never emits unused-method diagnostics, so there is nothing to suppress or replicate.
